title: Annex P MVP Compliance Monitoring Checklist
basis: ESMF Annex P, pp. 275-309; Operations Manual pp. 59-60

items.text: SES monitoring checklist is posted in a visible area.
GRM poster/directory is installed and visible at the site.
Traffic, warning signs, and community safety controls are in place.
Spoils, borrow pits, batching plants, and quarry sources are managed according to approved ESMP/CESMP.
Tree cutting, replacement, and remaining forest protection measures are implemented where applicable.
Worker PPE, OSH orientation, and incident/near-miss reporting are in place.
Enterprise operation follows the approved ESMP and operations manual.
Wastewater, solid waste, and hazardous waste controls are operational.
Worker OSH, code of conduct, and worker GRM measures are implemented.
Social inclusiveness and equitable benefit-sharing commitments are being monitored.
Accident/incident reports are documented and escalated where required.
Required consultations and disclosure commitments are documented.
Open safeguards requirements are tracked with responsible party and due date.
GRM uptake points and directory are available where applicable.
